The following events took place in '''28 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*7:10:5&mdash;[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] is [[Supreme Chancellor election, 28 BBY|reelected]] as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="I84" />
*8:2:11&mdash;Palpatine approves [[Measure 4213.0410]], sponsoring the [[Outbound Flight Project]].<ref name="I84" />
*[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] is [[Jedi Knight/Legends|knighted]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="ROP">''[[Star Wars: Rite of Passage]]''</ref>
*[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] is promoted to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] on Coruscant.<ref name="ROP" />
*The [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] take over [[Spice/Legends|spice]] processing on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="JQ">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] constructs his first [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and faces a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="JQ" />
*[[The Warlord]] gains control of [[Kariek]].
